_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Answering with a long sentence instead of a short natural phrase

segments.text: It means, maybe yes, maybe no.
Are you free on Sunday? It depends!

native.caption: Tu veux répondre « ça dépend » en anglais ? Dis “It depends” – cela veut dire peut-être oui, peut-être non. Exemple : “Are you free on Sunday?” – “It depends!”. Écoute Ama, puis répète pendant le silence. Continue dans l’appli Lexkite.

en.caption: Want to say “it depends” in English? Say “It depends” – it means maybe yes, maybe no. Example: “Are you free on Sunday?” – “It depends!”. Listen to Ama, then say it in the pause. Continue in the Lexkite app.
